items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: And we did it with Taj Mahal’s daughter who sang so soulfully, it was great.

ctx.x: Liberty, liberty, that was three and four. So you know those gigs are good if you can get it. But that’s sort of harkening back to [sings] “Buy Mennen.” Where it’s a sung jingle. Normally my requests are, not even — I just did one that was cool though, it was lean on me for Dove dishwashing soap and it was like washing the oil off birds’ wings and it was cool. And we did it with Taj Mahal’s daughter who sang so soulfully, it was great. It was great. So those are kind of fun to do. I try not to you know, to…
How do you figure out how to price those things?
